### Q1
No. We're keeping the JSON file store because ops backs up data/store.json with a nightly rsync job that diffs plain-text files, and a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. Instead, writes are debounced (200 ms) in src/store.ts, with a flush on shutdown.

### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ must not be modified. It's vendored from the old logistics monolith, and a platform-team sync job overwrites it every Monday, so any change would be silently lost. Also, docs/erp-api.md must not be edited (the ERP team owns it).

### Q3
The signature goes in the JSON body as a top-level `sig` field, computed over the body without `sig`. We first tried an `X-Signature` header, but the ERP's API gateway strips every custom X- header, so the ERP rejected everything as unsigned.

### Q4
The ERP sandbox listens on port 9911 (since the infra move in October). The doc and README still say 8080, which is outdated. The ERP team owns the doc, and you said you'd fix the README yourself.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because the warehouse staff UI shows them verbatim to the packers. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

### Q6
Holidays come from a hardcoded list for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, which `isBusinessDay` checks. It's hardcoded because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet access, so it has to work fully offline.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array payload and only accepts a single event object per request, so batching was not built.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, runtime or dev, because every new package has to go through the security review, which currently takes about six weeks.

### Q9
Yes. Memoization was added to `calculateEta` because the list was slow, then removed. QA reported stale ETAs after new events because the cache wasn't invalidated, and a proper cache key got messy. You said caching ETAs is a dead end, and pagination of the list endpoint is planned for later instead.

### Q10
There are 3 attempts in total with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff. The ERP deduplicates by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it, or duplicate events get created. The delay is injectable for tests.

### Q11
Never log the recipient's name, address or phone number. It's personal data under GDPR, and the data protection officer flagged it in the audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers may be logged.

### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts (OPS-412, a timer race in the fake notifier, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't try to fix it.

### Q13
Only carrier ATP is validated: the tracking number must be a valid UPU S10 number including the check digit, per docs/carriers.md. All other carriers accept any non-empty value, because their formats change often and valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days last year.

### Q14
Nothing is built yet. `fs.watch` was tried on staging and never fires, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and file change events don't propagate into the container. Polling with `fs.watchFile` works.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id must not change in any way. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and their next release isn't until January.
